title: Learning to Balance Altruism and Self-interest Based on Empathy in Mixed-Motive Games
reasoning: The paper focuses on computationally modeling and evaluating concepts such as 'empathy', 'altruism', and 'fairness' within multi-agent reinforcement learning. It specifically designs an algorithm (LASE) to balance self-interest with altruistic cooperation and uses fairness (Equality metric) as a primary evaluation criterion for performance.
